verdict: Mostly yes, after AG's pass. Of WB's six goals, AG's uncommitted tree (/Users/ren/tmp/ag/rv, branch ag-review) has re-said three (generative-alignment, universal-intelligence-session, zero-axiom-session) out of the two-readings frame: "C ordering, both named and neither asserted", "C needs its own reason", "C for order" and "warrant ... open question" are gone, replaced by the ethics emerging from continuation, self-concern as a hypothesis whose forming is not shown, and the warrant question set aside as one the map does not need, matching 07's Open item and the one page as they stand in that tree. WB's own proposals (FOR-OTHERS.md "For Ren": "how C-like orders form", "ranking ... under readings each comparison names") are in the frame Ren set aside and should not be taken. What still steers away: three unchanged goals carry it (theory-of-becoming's "comparison is a law with 'better' read as widening", the sentence Ren's 10 November message names; normative-grounding's two "warrant" clauses, which are the 7 October AI interpretation, not his words; and the practical-judgment goal, on both trees, still restates T8 as "for life, the way is 生生" when T8 now offers a way of seeing, not a verdict). One progress note says less than is there (LA4's Stage B is held, not "still to be frozen"). And AG's tree has not re-rendered GOALS.md/GOALS.zh.md, which are byte-identical to main's, so GOALS:104 would still show the old frame if the render is skipped at landing. Settled by his messages 10 to 12 and 10 November: C is not a premise giving order; there is no warrant; the ethics emerges from continuation; widening stays as a relation; no authority outside becoming. Those settle the re-saying of generative alignment, the ethics for life, practical judgment and the Theory of Becoming premises, which AG can land under "best decision, not word for word". Left for Ren's word: whether the 7 October "Continuing normative grounding direction" goal stays active, is marked, or is re-said (its aim is the universal grounding he set aside on 30 October and 9 November; goal states are his); and the wisdom-root premise, which is his own 8 October sentence and only he re-says. The wisdom-root premise should not be rewritten by WB's proposal.
